title: How to connect your retro GameCube to a modern TV - Engadget
summary: If you own a Switch 2 , Nintendo offers a selection of emulated GameCube games through its Nintendo Switch Online service. As of August 2026, there are nine GameCube games available through Nintendo Switch Online, with two more on the way.
